text:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning orders_v3 schema migration TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. Owners: @lia (backfills) + @mike (dual-write). Requesting a 2h quiet window starting 01:50 for warmups.
lia: Ack, I can own backfill watches. I’ll run the preflight summary at T-3h and post smoke results at T-30m.
mike: I’ll handle dual-write flip and rollback script. Will be on standby from 01:30–03:30 UTC.
jess: I can take the 02:00–02:30 oncall for customer-facing monitoring. Ping me before cut.
anita: Code review LGTM for the migration job. small nit in comments but not blocking.
sam: Thanks. Quick checklist (copyable):
```
- T-3h: run `migctl preflight orders_v3` (lia)
- T-1h: warm up replicas, priming traffic to new index (infra)
- T-30m: smoke run in staging, share results (lia)
- T-10m: deploy migration job to canary hosts (sam)
- T+0m: enable dual-write, monitor error-rate <0.5% (mike)
- T+15m: begin slow rollback if errors >1% for 5m (rollback script)
- T+60m: start backfill (lia)
- T+120m: confirm metrics and close window
```
mike: Rollback plan is `rollback_orders_v3.sh --snapshot <ts>` (tested in staging). I’ll post the exact invocation in the channel before T-10m.
deploy-bot: slot reserved: orders_v3-migration by sam at 2026-06-18T02:00:00Z (quiet-window: 120m) :calendar:
lia: For backfills: using 4 workers, rate-limited to 500r/s, will pause if replication lag > 200ms.
sam: Who can own alert paging if the error spike fires? prefer someone not onrotation.
jess: I can take the pager for first 30m then hand to oncall if no issues.
anita: I’ll watch DB locks and schema-change metrics. I’ll flag if DDL locks >30s.
ops-bot: reminder: dashboards -> Orders > Orders_v3 migration health. Alert thresholds preconfigured.
sam: small ask — @mike please add a one-liner to the PR describing the dual-write revert steps (so anyone can execute).
mike: done, pushed to PR #7421.
lia: I’ll post the staging smoke logs at T-28m. If anyone wants me to run extra prompt sets, say now.
jess: please run the high-traffic scenario (500rps burst) in staging, thanks.
lia: will do. ETA T-2m.
sam: OK team — final confirm please: lia, mike, jess, anita. Reply with :thumbsup: if good.
lia: :thumbsup:
mike: :thumbsup:
jess: :thumbsup:
anita: :thumbsup: 
sam: Great. I’ll post a short preflight at T-3h and update this thread with links. If anything changes, call it out here or DM.
deploy-bot: automated note: migration window aligned with infra maintenance window eu-west-1. If mismatch, reply to this thread.
lia: copied. will sync with infra team right after preflight.
mike: see you all tomorrow — I’ll have rollback ready and the revert command in pinned messages.
sam: Thanks everyone, closing coordination thread.
